definition: The amount of space inside a solid, measured in cubic units such as $\text{cm}^{3}$ or $\text{m}^{3}$.

The total area of all the faces and curved surfaces of a solid, measured in square units such as $\text{cm}^{2}$; the curved surface area of a cylinder or cone counts only the curved part, not the flat circles.
The flat shape you see when you cut straight through a solid; a prism has the same cross-section all the way along its length.
The distance from the top point of a cone down its sloping side to the edge of the base; on a pyramid, it is the height of a triangular face, measured at right angles to that face's base edge.
